name: Pension for Agitators Who were Jailed for 7 Days or Injured During the Uttarakhand State Movement
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an agitator who was jailed for 7 days or injured during the Uttarakhand State Movement. 1. The applicant must be unable to gain employment due to certain reasons.
